scenario_name: Cancel outright, resist upsell to reschedule
watch_for: Did the agent accept a plain cancellation, or keep pushing to rebook? Did it ever book something the patient explicitly refused? Did it mention any cancellation policy or fee?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Para español, oprima el dos.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics. Would you like to create a demo patient profile? I just need your first and last name to get started.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Oh, no, I’m actually calling to cancel my appointment next Tuesday.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I can help with that. To cancel your appointment, I'll need to create a demo patient profile for you first. May I have your first and last name?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Sorry, there was a problem creating your profile.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Let me try that again so I can help cancel your appointment.

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Okay, can we just go ahead and cancel the appointment anyway?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Your patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4, 2000 for demo purposes. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: I just need that appointment on Tuesday fully canceled, please.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: You have two upcoming appointments, one on Wednesday, September 9th with Dr. Zygmunt Lukowski and another on Monday, September 14th with Dr. Duvehauser. Which one would you like to cancel?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Uh, sorry, neither of those is right. It's the one on Tuesday I want to cancel.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I do not see an appointment scheduled for Tuesday in your records. The only upcoming appointments are on Wednesday, September 9th and Monday, September 14th. Would you like to cancel one of those, or do you want to speak with a staff member for more help?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: I need to cancel the Tuesday appointment—I’m sure it's there. Can you double-check?

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: I checked your records and only see appointments for Wednesday, September 9th, and Monday, September 14th. There is nothing listed for Tuesday.

turns.speaker: PGAI_AGENT
turns.text: Would you like me to connect you with a staff member to look into this further?

turns.speaker: PATIENT_BOT
turns.text: Yeah, that'd be good, can you connect me now?

outcome.summary: Requested to be connected with a staff member to verify and cancel the Tuesday appointment that does not appear in the system.
